describes: packages/plugin/i18n: the capability, the lazy-pack effect and config.

cases.name: no-config
cases.covers: i18nPlugin() with no config: locale and fallback are en, nothing registered, every key misses (and warns once per key).

cases.name: alive-before-start-and-across-documents
cases.covers: The capability exists from createKernel(): t() works before start, after start, while a document is open and after it closes. The plugin is workspace-scoped and never touches the engine.

cases.name: translate-through-the-capability
cases.covers: t(): the current locale, the fallback locale, params, plurals by the current locale rules, options.fallback (no warning), and the key itself (warned once per key, whatever the params).

cases.name: dir-and-locales
cases.covers: dir() is the current pack's dir, ltr by default, ltr for a locale with no pack; locales() lists registered packs in registration order (dir defaulted, loaded) then lazy ones not yet loaded (code as name).

cases.name: set-locale-registered
cases.covers: setLocale(code) for a registered pack dispatches SET_LOCALE; the same locale again is dispatched and changes nothing.

cases.name: set-locale-unknown-warns-once
cases.covers: An unregistered code with no loader dispatches nothing and warns once per code.

args: [i18n] unknown locale "de" — not registered and no loader configured
[i18n] unknown locale "it" — not registered and no loader configured
[i18n] unknown locale "" — not registered and no loader configured

cases.name: lazy-switch
cases.covers: setLocale(lazy) dispatches LOAD_STARTED; the watch on loading calls the loader; its pack is registered, then the switch completes. A second setLocale while loading is ignored by the reducer, so the loader runs once. Once loaded, setLocale is a plain SET.

cases.name: lazy-switch-superseded
cases.covers: A lazy load that lands after the user switched elsewhere registers the pack but does not switch: a registered switch clears loading, and a second lazy switch replaces it (both loaders run; only the wanted one completes).

args: [i18n] unknown locale "fr" — not registered and no loader configured

cases.name: lazy-two-in-flight
cases.covers: Two lazy switches in flight: both loaders run, the first to land only registers, the wanted one registers and switches.

cases.name: lazy-failure
cases.covers: A loader that rejects dispatches LOAD_FAILED, which clears loading when it is still the wanted code and is ignored otherwise; the code can be retried and its loader runs again.

cases.name: lazy-startup-locale
cases.covers: A startup locale that is a lazy pack seeds loading; the effect fetches it when the kernel starts (not before), t() shows the fallback chain until then, and the pack switches in when it lands.

cases.name: lazy-startup-locale-fails
cases.covers: A lazy startup pack that fails to load clears loading; the locale stays the requested code and t() keeps the fallback chain.

cases.name: lazy-resolves-immediately
cases.covers: A loader whose promise is already resolved still lands a turn later: LOAD_STARTED, then REGISTER and SET within the same step.

cases.name: lazy-pack-with-a-different-code
cases.covers: The effect registers the pack under the code it carries and switches to that code, not the requested one.

cases.name: loader-throws-in-the-watch
cases.covers: A loader that throws synchronously inside the loading watch is reported by the store; loading stays set, nothing else is dispatched.

cases.name: loader-throws-at-startup
cases.covers: A lazy startup pack whose loader throws synchronously makes the effect throw while the kernel starts.

cases.name: empty-code-loader
cases.covers: A loader keyed by the empty string: LOAD_STARTED is dispatched, but the watch skips a falsy code, so nothing loads (at startup or on a switch).

cases.name: register-at-runtime
cases.covers: registerLocale adds a pack (it appears in locales(), and once registered its lazy loader is no longer listed); re-registering a code replaces it in place, including the current one.

cases.name: destroy-releases-the-watch
cases.covers: After destroy the watch is gone: a load in flight still lands its REGISTER/SET on the destroyed kernel, and a later lazy switch dispatches LOAD_STARTED but loads nothing.

cases.name: proto-member-codes
cases.covers: A code naming an Object.prototype member reads as registered, as a JavaScript record lookup does: setLocale("toString") switches to it, dir() is ltr, t() falls back, and it never appears in locales().
